chunks: 'Ali b. 'Abd Allah al-Warraq narrated to us, from Sa'd b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Khalaf, from 'Imran b. Musa, from al-Hasan b. 'Ali b. al-Nu'man, from Muhammad b. Fudayl b. Ghazwan al-Dabbi, who said: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ishaq informed me, from al-Nu'man b. Sa'd, who said: The Commander of the Faithful 'Ali b. Abi Talib (blessings of Allah upon him) said:

A man from my offspring will be killed in the land of Khurasan by poison unjustly. His name is my name, and the name of his father is the name of the son of Imran, Musa (peace be upon him). Indeed, whoever visits him in his exile, Allah will forgive his sins — those past and future — even if they were like the number of stars, drops of rain, and leaves of trees.

key_terms.زيارة: Visitation (ziyara) — pilgrimage to an Imam's shrine
key_terms.عارفاً بحقه: Recognizing his right — acknowledging his divinely appointed Imamate
key_terms.غربة: Exile/alienation — Imam al-Rida's burial far from his homeland

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali prophesy about the martyrdom and visitation of Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) prophesied: 'A man from my offspring will be killed in the land of Khurasan by poison unjustly. His name is my name, and the name of his father is the name of the son of Imran, Musa (peace be upon him). Indeed, whoever visits him in his exile, Allah will forgive his sins — those past and future — even if they were like the number of stars, drops of rain, and leaves of trees.' This powerful prophecy from Imam Ali identifies Imam al-Rida by name (Ali, son of Musa) and promises complete forgiveness for his visitors.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. `Abdullah al-Warraq narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah b. Abi Khalaf narrated to us. He said: `Imran b. Musa narrated to us from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. al-Nu`man from Muhammad b. Fudayl b. Ghazwan al-Dabi. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. Ishaq informed me from al-Nu`man b. Sa`d. He said: Amir al-Mu’minin `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) said:

A man from my descendants will be killed oppressively with poison in the land of Khurasan. His name is my name, and the name of his father is the name of the son of `Imran, Musa (as). Surely, whoever visits him in his isolation, Allah will forgive his past and future sins, even if they are similar in number to the stars, rain droplets, and leaves on trees.
